description: EXAMPLE — a target repo's renovate.json after scaffolding + local edits. Strict JSON (no // comments) so the baseline's own check-json pre-commit hook accepts it; annotations live in Renovate-native 'description' fields. Doubles as the spec for the managed-keys drift rule.

MANAGED (synced; check_drift enforces): '$schema' must equal the baseline value, and 'extends' must CONTAIN 'github>Knowledgemonger-LLC/renovate-config'. Removing/renaming that preset, or changing $schema, is drift.
EDITABLE (repo-owned, allowed alongside the managed keys, never flagged): packageRules, schedule, and additional extends presets.

packageRules.description: EDITABLE: group and automerge non-major npm updates.
